visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Five young adults (three women and two men) are gathered in a well-lit living room, sitting on a grey sofa decorated with patterned cushions. A woman wearing a blue denim jacket enters from the right and pours a bag of snack sticks onto a white plate on the coffee table. Everyone is smiling and cheering enthusiastically. (2) The woman in blue holds up a pair of wooden chopsticks as if presenting a solution. The camera zooms in on the plate of snacks. The group watches with interest. (3) The group is shown in a montage holding chopsticks and picking up individual snack sticks, looking impressed and nodding. One woman in a pink hoodie is seen mimicking a shocked expression. (4) The scene transitions to a bedroom setting where a woman in a purple hoodie is reading a book under a blanket. Next to her, a man is playing a mobile game while they both eat snacks using chopsticks. (5) An extreme close-up shows a woman's face as she eats a fry dipped in ketchup, ignoring the fresh tomato slices on the side. (6) In a kitchen setting, a woman and a man are eating. The woman peels the bread off a meat bun, eats the meat, and hands the empty bun to the man. (7) On a sofa, a man uses chopsticks to meticulously pick oysters out of an oyster omelet and put them into a small bowl. A woman next to him stares at him with a deadpan and increasingly annoyed facial expression.
